_help: AI-designed static formats (layout 'ad', ideas.py; owner 2026-10-26: 'make them unique each time we run a batch ... new ideas and new formats that follow Meta guidelines'). Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5 makes the WHOLE ad from the real packshot: the picture and the exact words of the sheet (ai_gen.build_ad_prompt adds `art`, the keep-the-real-bag text, the words rule and the people rule). The strategist picks a format here or invents a new one (format id not in this file + format_name + art), each format at most once a batch and not one the product's last batch used (ideas.check). people: none (nobody in the picture) | behind (one person seen only from behind, no face) | cropped (cut at the shoulders). words: the most words the ad may carry (all lines together). liked: the owner's pick of the 2026-10-26 test (the number on the test sheet). A format that worked for an invented slug can be added here later.
meta: Only true claims from the strategy packet's facts; no exact prices while the price test runs (a % is fine: the sale's own words).

No fake interface: no play buttons, notification bubbles, chat bubbles, sliders, cursors, checkboxes or 'Shop now' buttons drawn as if they could be tapped (Meta rejects ads that imitate system or app features).
No before / after, no 'you' with a personal attribute (body, age, health, money trouble), nothing sensational or shocking.
No other brand's name or logo, no celebrity, no real publication's name (the magazine masthead is LIBRA).
Few words: one headline and at most two short lines; the picture carries the ad.
Words big enough to read on a phone in the feed: a tiny label or caption is wasted (the prompt asks for it; look at the contact sheet).

formats.name: Fashion magazine cover
formats.art: A premium fashion-magazine cover, shot and laid out like a real printed issue: the bag photographed large as the cover star on a seamless studio backdrop in one rich colour, soft directional studio light with a gentle shadow, a tall elegant serif masthead across the top behind the top of the bag, a few short cover lines in a clean sans-serif down the left side, generous margins, the look of glossy paper.
formats.words_hint: masthead LIBRA + 2-3 cover lines of 3-6 words (one may be the sale)
formats.type: the masthead in a tall high-contrast serif, the cover lines in a clean condensed sans-serif

formats.name: Feature diagram with callouts
formats.art: A clean product infographic: the bag photographed straight-on on a plain light backdrop, centred and large, with thin straight leader lines from each feature to a short label set neatly at the left and right edges, a headline at the top, lots of white space, like a premium catalogue page.
formats.words_hint: a headline + 3-4 labels of 2-4 words; only features you can SEE from the reference's angle (a back pocket needs the back view: scene.ref)
formats.type: the headline in a refined serif, the labels in a clear medium-weight sans-serif
formats.bag: Only label what is visible from this angle; each leader line points exactly at the part it names.

formats.name: Bold one-colour poster
formats.art: A bold graphic poster: one saturated flat colour fills the frame, the bag photographed as a clean cut-out with a soft natural drop shadow, very large heavy type that fills the width above it, one small line below, nothing else, confident Swiss-style layout.
formats.type: the big words in a heavy bold grotesque sans-serif, the small line in the same family, light weight

formats.name: POV street photo from behind
formats.art: A candid phone photo taken by a friend walking a few steps behind her: real street life, slightly off-centre framing, natural mixed light (shop windows, dusk sky or daylight), a little motion blur in the passers-by, real clothes with creases and texture, ordinary city details, nothing glossy, staged or computer-made. One short caption in bold white sans-serif with a soft shadow sits large across the empty sky or wall area, the way people caption a photo.
formats.words_hint: one caption that starts 'POV:' (at most 12 words)
formats.type: a bold white sans-serif caption with a soft dark shadow, sentence case, set large on two or three lines
formats.people_note: She is seen only from behind, walking away from the camera, her head turned forward, the bag on her shoulder towards the camera; nobody else faces the camera.
example: POV: your bag stays zipped in the crowd

formats.name: Top-down flat lay
formats.art: A top-down flat lay photographed from directly above on a real surface (oak table, linen, marble), soft window light from one side with natural shadows, the bag zipped shut in the middle and the everyday things it holds laid neatly around it, a calm empty area at the top for a short serif headline and one small line.
formats.words_hint: a 2-4 word headline + one small line
formats.type: the headline in an elegant serif, the line in a small sans-serif
formats.bag: The bag is closed (zipped): never show its inside; the items lie next to it, not in it.

formats.name: Real-home gift moment
formats.art: A candid photo of a real, lived-in home in soft daylight from a window (a sofa or armchair with a throw, a book, a cup of tea), the bag sitting there with a slightly uneven satin ribbon around its handle and a small brown kraft-paper tag tied to it with string, the tag written by hand in pen with real ink. Natural colours, not glossy, no studio look. One short headline set in a clean serif in a calm empty part of the room.
formats.words_hint: the handwritten tag (1-3 words: 'For Mum', 'For you') + a short headline
formats.type: the tag in natural handwriting in dark ink, the headline in a clean serif

formats.name: Editorial still life
formats.art: A luxury editorial still life: the bag on a sculptural plinth or a stack of stone blocks, a few simple props (dried flowers, a ceramic vase, a folded silk scarf), one warm hard light making crisp shadows, a muted two-tone backdrop, composed like a high-end catalogue page, a small serif headline in the empty corner.
formats.words_hint: a 2-5 word headline + an optional small line
formats.type: a small elegant serif, generous letter spacing

formats.name: Split-screen comparison
formats.art: A clean split-screen comparison: on the left a plain generic open-top tote bag (no brand, no logo) on a muted grey backdrop, on the right the real bag on a warm tinted backdrop, the same light on both, a short label under each side and one headline across the top.
formats.words_hint: a headline + one 2-3 word label per side (true facts only: 'Open top' vs 'Zips shut')
formats.type: the headline in a bold sans-serif, the labels in small caps
formats.bag: The other bag is a generic plain tote, never a brand, never shown as broken or bad: just different.

formats.name: Poster on a city wall
formats.art: A real photo of a city street: a large printed paper poster pasted on a wall or in a bus-shelter frame, slightly weathered edges, daylight with real reflections, pavement and street details around it. The poster shows the bag large on a solid colour with one short headline. Shot at a slight angle like a passer-by took it.
formats.words_hint: a 2-5 word headline on the poster + an optional small line
formats.type: the poster headline in a heavy sans-serif

formats.name: Macro detail close-up
formats.art: An extreme close-up macro photograph of one detail of the bag (the gold zip pull, the pebbled leather grain, the stitching where the handle meets the ring), razor-sharp on the detail with a soft fall-off, warm natural light, the colour of the reference exact, a short line of text in the soft out-of-focus area.
formats.words_hint: one short line about that detail
formats.type: a clean small sans-serif or serif
formats.bag: Only a detail the reference image shows clearly.

formats.name: Unboxing from above
formats.art: A top-down photo of hands lifting the bag out of a plain gift box with tissue paper, on a real table in soft daylight, only the hands and forearms in frame (natural hands, relaxed fingers, no rings or nail art), a short serif line in the empty table area.

formats.name: Travel day snapshot
formats.art: A candid travel photo: a woman seen from behind walking through a bright airport or train station with a small carry-on, the bag on her shoulder, large windows, real people blurred far away and facing away, natural daylight, documentary phone-photo look, one short caption in plain white sans-serif in the empty upper area.
formats.type: a plain white sans-serif with a soft shadow
formats.people_note: She is seen only from behind; every other person is far away, blurred and facing away.

formats.name: Colour-block studio set
formats.art: A playful studio set built from two or three solid colour blocks (a pastel cube, a curved step, a backdrop) that pick up the bag's colour, the bag resting on a block, soft even studio light, crisp clean shadows, one short line in bold sans-serif on the plain backdrop.

formats.name: Boutique window display
formats.art: A photo through the glass of a small boutique window at dusk: the bag displayed on a stand inside, warm interior light, soft street reflections on the glass, a short line of text painted on the window in neat gold sign-writing.
formats.words_hint: the window lettering: 2-5 words (the sale line works)
formats.type: gold sign-writing on glass, classic serif
